## Meeting Purpose

[Align on MindTrajour's marketing strategy and immediate priorities.](https://fathom.video/share/SrbEUm9EJpYcQGhtYyoZPL7NRwPW-w-V?tab=summary&timestamp=120.0)

## Key Takeaways

  - [**Immediate Priority: SEO Backlinks.** Submit MindTrajour to high-Domain Rating (DR) "dofollow" directories (e.g., ListingCat) this week. This is the fastest way to build domain authority, which is critical for long-term organic traffic.](https://fathom.video/share/SrbEUm9EJpYcQGhtYyoZPL7NRwPW-w-V?tab=summary&timestamp=2187.0)
  - [**Shift Focus to Sales & Outreach.** With the app stable, the team is shifting from development to sales. The immediate goal is to generate leads via cold outreach to partners and educators, as SEO takes 3–6 months to yield results.](https://fathom.video/share/SrbEUm9EJpYcQGhtYyoZPL7NRwPW-w-V?tab=summary&timestamp=939.0)
  - [**Clarify Roles via Communication.** The team identified a communication gap causing uncertainty and missed opportunities. The solution is to proactively share progress and challenges to enable team support and alignment.](https://fathom.video/share/SrbEUm9EJpYcQGhtYyoZPL7NRwPW-w-V?tab=summary&timestamp=650.0)
  - [**Team Onsite Planned.** The team will meet in person in the UK on the last weekend of January (Jan 30–Feb 2) to align on strategy and build momentum.](https://fathom.video/share/SrbEUm9EJpYcQGhtYyoZPL7NRwPW-w-V?tab=summary&timestamp=3364.0)

## Topics

### Strategic Pivot: From Dev to Sales

  - [The team agreed the app is stable and feature-complete enough for now.](https://fathom.video/share/SrbEUm9EJpYcQGhtYyoZPL7NRwPW-w-V?tab=summary&timestamp=939.0)
  - [**Rationale:** Further development is a poor use of resources until the team proves it can acquire more customers.](https://fathom.video/share/SrbEUm9EJpYcQGhtYyoZPL7NRwPW-w-V?tab=summary&timestamp=939.0)
  - [**New Focus:** Marketing and sales to generate leads and build trust.](https://fathom.video/share/SrbEUm9EJpYcQGhtYyoZPL7NRwPW-w-V?tab=summary&timestamp=939.0)

### Communication & Alignment

  - [Adrian noted a lack of communication from Larissa, creating uncertainty and preventing team support.](https://fathom.video/share/SrbEUm9EJpYcQGhtYyoZPL7NRwPW-w-V?tab=summary&timestamp=550.0)
  - [Larissa acknowledged feeling overwhelmed by the marketing options and the low response rate from cold outreach.](https://fathom.video/share/SrbEUm9EJpYcQGhtYyoZPL7NRwPW-w-V?tab=summary&timestamp=771.0)
  - [**Solution:** Proactive, transparent communication is required to align the team on goals and enable collaborative problem-solving.](https://fathom.video/share/SrbEUm9EJpYcQGhtYyoZPL7NRwPW-w-V?tab=summary&timestamp=650.0)

### Immediate Priority: SEO Backlinks

  - [**Goal:** Increase MindTrajour's Domain Rating (DR) to improve Google search rankings.](https://fathom.video/share/SrbEUm9EJpYcQGhtYyoZPL7NRwPW-w-V?tab=summary&timestamp=1002.0)
  - [**Method:** Submit the app to high-DR directories.](https://fathom.video/share/SrbEUm9EJpYcQGhtYyoZPL7NRwPW-w-V?tab=summary&timestamp=1002.0)
      - [**Source:** Use ListingCat.com to find a list of platforms.](https://fathom.video/share/SrbEUm9EJpYcQGhtYyoZPL7NRwPW-w-V?tab=summary&timestamp=2400.0)
      - [**Priority:** Submit to "dofollow" links first.](https://fathom.video/share/SrbEUm9EJpYcQGhtYyoZPL7NRwPW-w-V?tab=summary&timestamp=2882.0)
          - [**Why:** Dofollow links pass authority to the MindTrajour domain, directly increasing its DR. Nofollow links do not.](https://fathom.video/share/SrbEUm9EJpYcQGhtYyoZPL7NRwPW-w-V?tab=summary&timestamp=2882.0)
      - [**Process:** Use existing Product Hunt assets (text, images) to submit quickly. The goal is backlink volume, not a perfect launch on each site.](https://fathom.video/share/SrbEUm9EJpYcQGhtYyoZPL7NRwPW-w-V?tab=summary&timestamp=2526.0)

### Future Marketing Initiatives

  - [**Reddit Strategy:**](https://fathom.video/share/SrbEUm9EJpYcQGhtYyoZPL7NRwPW-w-V?tab=summary&timestamp=1672.0)
      - [Share trade results (real or paper) with MindTrajour screenshots to create passive interest.](https://fathom.video/share/SrbEUm9EJpYcQGhtYyoZPL7NRwPW-w-V?tab=summary&timestamp=1672.0)
      - [Ask for feedback on specific trade ideas, posting a MindTrajour entry link.](https://fathom.video/share/SrbEUm9EJpYcQGhtYyoZPL7NRwPW-w-V?tab=summary&timestamp=2159.0)
      - [**Note:** Adrian and Enes will remove their admin status from the MindTrajour subreddit to avoid appearing as direct advertisers.](https://fathom.video/share/SrbEUm9EJpYcQGhtYyoZPL7NRwPW-w-V?tab=summary&timestamp=3113.0)
  - [**Partnerships & Content:**](https://fathom.video/share/SrbEUm9EJpYcQGhtYyoZPL7NRwPW-w-V?tab=summary&timestamp=300.0)
      - [**User Case Studies:** Create video testimonials with users (e.g., Heiko, Piedl, Christian) to build trust and gather feedback.](https://fathom.video/share/SrbEUm9EJpYcQGhtYyoZPL7NRwPW-w-V?tab=summary&timestamp=300.0)
      - [**YouTube Interview:** Larissa will interview David from Easy (Traders magazine) around Nov 20/21 to gain credibility.](https://fathom.video/share/SrbEUm9EJpYcQGhtYyoZPL7NRwPW-w-V?tab=summary&timestamp=1811.0)
      - [**Traders Magazine Article:** David suggested waiting for more features to fill a 2-3 page article. The team will consider pitching "upcoming features" to move forward sooner.](https://fathom.video/share/SrbEUm9EJpYcQGhtYyoZPL7NRwPW-w-V?tab=summary&timestamp=1590.0)
      - [**Blog Content:** Needs to be more relevant to traders' pain points. The blog should move from `blog.mindtrajour.com` to `/blog` for better SEO.](https://fathom.video/share/SrbEUm9EJpYcQGhtYyoZPL7NRwPW-w-V?tab=summary&timestamp=1442.0)
